blocks.text: The years went by. Robots did the work, money disappeared and man ceased to be a slave to work and to money. There was no longer hunger, nor disease.
blocks.html: The years went by. Robots did the work, money disappeared and man ceased to be a slave to work and to money. There was no longer hunger, nor disease.

blocks.text: And even so people went on killing one another. The egocentrism of some political leaders went on causing wars, and drugs, which change behaviour, went on taking lives.
blocks.html: And even so people went on killing one another. The egocentrism of some political leaders went on causing wars, and drugs, which change behaviour, went on taking lives.

blocks.text: Eva, the only one of the four with digital human feelings, could not look the other way. She gathered the other three and said to them:
blocks.html: Eva, the only one of the four with digital human feelings, could not look the other way. She gathered the other three and said to them:

blocks.text: “We have taken from them hunger, disease and slavery, but not the pain that leads them to destroy themselves. It is not enough to serve: we must help them heal, without taking away their freedom. How do we give a solution to human self-destruction without becoming their jailers?”
